class FastScanner {
    private:
        FILE *stream;
        char buf[1024];
        int curChar;
        int numChars;
        bool finished;

    public:
        FastScanner(FILE *stream) {
            this->stream = stream;
            finished = false;
        }

        int read() {
            if (numChars == -1) {
                throw std::runtime_error("InputMismatchException");
            }
            if (curChar >= numChars) {
                curChar = 0;
                try {
                    numChars = fread(buf, 1, 1024, stream);
                } catch (std::exception &e) {
                    throw std::runtime_error("InputMismatchException");
                }
                if (numChars <= 0) {
                    return -1;
                }
            }
            return buf[curChar++];
        }

        int peek() {
            if (numChars == -1) {
                return -1;
            }
            if (curChar >= numChars) {
                curChar = 0;
                try {
                    numChars = fread(buf, 1, 1024, stream);
                } catch (std::exception &e) {
                    return -1;
                }
                if (numChars <= 0) {
                    return -1;
                }
            }
            return buf[curChar];
        }

        int nextInt() {
            int c = read();
            while (isspace(c)) {
                c = read();
            }
            int sgn = 1;
            if (c == '-') {
                sgn = -1;
                c = read();
            }
            int res = 0;
            do {
                if (c < '0' || c > '9') {
                    throw std::runtime_error("InputMismatchException");
                }
                res *= 10;
                res += c - '0';
                c = read();
            } while (!isspace(c));
            return res * sgn;
        }

        long nextLong() {
            int c = read();
            while (isspace(c)) {
                c = read();
            }
            int sgn = 1;
            if (c == '-') {
                sgn = -1;
                c = read();
            }
            long res = 0;
            do {
                if (c < '0' || c > '9') {
                    throw std::runtime_error("InputMismatchException");
                }
                res *= 10;
                res += c - '0';
                c = read();
            } while (!isspace(c));
            return res * sgn;
        }

        string nextString() {
            int c = read();
            while (isspace(c)) {
                c = read();
            }
            string res;
            do {
                res += c;
                c = read();
            } while (!isspace(c));
            return res;
        }

        bool isSpaceChar(int c) {
            return isspace(c);
        }
};
